M6.name: 声音、音乐、对白与歌词关系
M6.validation_status: external recorded validation; definition alone is not execution
M6.goal: 在单次SoundPlan作用范围内协调四分区和未决问题，并唯一接受版本化声音计划。
M6.trigger: 完整声音规划、跨分区冲突、子提案接受或变更复验。
M6.write_scope: whole SoundPlan acceptance only; child semantic values are not rewritten
M6.output: M6ToolResult.state containing a new M6State draft, or rejection diagnostics
M6.parent_child_boundary: M6.1–M6.4 own professional candidates; M6 alone checks the atomic transition and records receipts.
required_dependencies: four public child contracts 1.0.0 for their applicable partitions
Python standard library when executing CLI
optional_dependencies: compatible external plans or user data
M6.return_to: original caller and actual registered consumers
M6.failure_return: diagnostic repair_target owning the field; no partial acceptance
M6.operation_effect: returns new JSON only; no file writes, media generation, external service or uploads
M6.retry_policy: same accepted proposals produce same state; altered receipt identity rejects
M6.compatibility: 1.0.0 only; breaking changes require version and migration records

HC: HC-03 parent checks cross-partition sound relations
LC: LC-01 closed public versioned minimum inputs
LC-02 copied immutable context and projections
LC-03 ExternalContext or reasoned unknown alternatives
LC-04 read-path based invalidation, no forced upstream calls
MD: MD-01 four separately routed/checkable child contracts
MD-02 replaceable standard JSON producer/consumer boundaries
MD-03 one partition per child; atomic parent acceptance
MD-04 all runtime resources bundled; Python standard library only
RT: RT-02 resource selection by target module
RT-03 child professional work remains distinct from routing/check scripts
RT-05 request-bound retries and creative revision versions
RT-06 call IDs, input/resource digests, source versions and actual dependency impact

architecture.authority_model: child proposals; parent M6 alone accepts versioned SoundPlan; no silent semantic rewrite
architecture.domain_vs_backend: M6 owns sound semantics; M2 stable assets/permissions; M7 timing; M8 state; M9 editing; M11 final labels/compiler; M12 media observations
architecture.independent_installation: One package containing five independently callable public responsibility nodes; four child nodes do not require four installable packages.

runtime.side_effects: none; commands print JSON and do not mutate input files
runtime.agent_role: Agent reads scoped professional references and makes domain decisions; route does not invoke an Agent or read every returned resource.

route_policy.dispatch: An explicit M6Request.target chooses M6 or one M6.N node. Agent natural-language entry uses SKILL.md description and its task table.
route_policy.parent_route: M6 can return four child routes; each child still needs its own minimal request, not an implicit execution of siblings.
route_policy.success_return: Structured diagnostics and M6Proposal; parent accept returns M6ToolResult.state as a new draft.
route_policy.unknown: Missing required input is blocked; explicit unknown retains scope and unverified status without manufacturing evidence.
route_policy.repair: Return issue owner and path; semantic changes return to their field owner. No automatic cross-module recursive calls.
route_policy.retry: Pure route/check/impact may repeat. Exact accepted proposal retry is idempotent; modified content requires a new proposal ID and current base version.
route_policy.termination: Stop the affected conclusion on unresolved blocking issues; continue independent supported scope; do not retry indefinitely to manufacture a pass.
route_policy.trace: ToolResult.trace records call/operation IDs, versions, request IDs, input hashes, source versions, loaded schema/registry hashes, side effects, status and error codes.
route_policy.invalidation: Consumers register real read_paths; impact intersects changed paths with their ancestors/descendants, preserving pre-existing stale flags. Undeclared semantic dependencies require Agent review.

compatibility.breaking_change_policy: New contract version plus explicit migration/affected-consumer notes; no silent coercion of M1-M5 or incompatible M6 records.
compatibility.alternative_producer: User data, approved existing plans or another implementation can satisfy the same typed contract without running named upstream modules.
